name: lumo-ui
description: Jetpack Compose UI component skill for lumo-ui — a Gradle plugin that generates production-ready Compose components (Button, TextField, ModalBottomSheet, NavigationBar, TopBar, and 19 more) into Android or KMP projects. Actions: setup plugin, generate components, configure theming, add components via CLI, customize generated code. Platforms: Android, Kotlin Multiplatform.
